capabilities: move newly created root-level files into an inbox folder
provide an interface to refile inbox notes into other folders
remind you periodically to clear the inbox
configure the watched folder and inbox folder in settings
problem: Obsidian's default new-note location drops files in the vault root, where they accumulate unorganized with no built-in triage workflow.
summary: Inbox manager that moves newly created root-level notes into an inbox folder and periodically prompts you to file them into other folders.
